person.name: Barend Verbeek
person.relationshipContext: direct Verbeek line; son of Hendrik Verbeek and Maria Magdalena van den Berg

researchFocus: occupation and household life in the 1860s

claims.claim: On the official-derived birth registration of his son Hendrik Verbeek, born 13 April 1868 in Heerewaarden, Barend Verbeek is recorded as 42 years old and an arbeider (labourer).

source.collection: Burgerlijke stand Gelderland, dubbelen, Heerewaarden, BS Geboorte

claims.claim: A secondary genealogy reports Barend's occupation in 1864 as boerenknecht and his marriage to Geertruida van Aalst on 2 April 1864 in Varik (akte 6, Gelders Archief).
claims.reason: Useful lead, but this run did not retrieve the underlying official marriage index/scan; occupation should not be published yet.

chronology.event: marriage to Geertruida van Aalst; secondary source also says occupation boerenknecht
birth registration of son Hendrik; Barend recorded as 42-year-old arbeider

interpretation.text: If the 1864 marriage record confirms boerenknecht, the evidence would document a useful occupational transition/name change from the more specific agricultural servant 'boerenknecht' in 1864 to the broader 'arbeider' in 1868. This must not be stated as fact until the 1864 primary/official-derived record is checked.

openQuestions: Does the original/official-derived Varik marriage record of 2 April 1864 explicitly call Barend a boerenknecht?
What occupations are recorded for Barend on the birth registrations of his other children between 1864 and 1876?
Can population registers establish the household's exact addresses and move from Varik to Heerewaarden?
publicationPolicy: The 1868 occupation arbeider is suitable for public presentation as CONFIRMED with citation. Keep boerenknecht (1864) research-only until the underlying official record is retrieved.
